1 Race Car Vehicle Dynamics — William F. Milliken & Douglas L. Milliken | Vehicle Dynamics | A foundational race engineering reference for understanding vehicle dynamics and car setup.
2 Tire and Vehicle Dynamics — Hans B. Pacejka | Tires | A foundational tire-modeling reference, including Magic Formula concepts. Tire modeling is valuable for students pursuing race engineering.
3 Analysis Techniques for Racecar Data Acquisition — Jorge Segers | Data Analysis | Recommended to me by Aylor Huneycutt. A strong introduction and guide to motorsports data analysis.
4 Suspension Geometry and Computation — John C. Dixon | Suspension | My favorite of the suspension books listed.

5 The Science of Vehicle Dynamics: Handling, Braking, and Ride of Road and Race Cars — Massimo Guiggiani | Vehicle Dynamics | A rigorous treatment of vehicle dynamics, covering handling, braking, and ride for road and race cars.

6 Chassis Design: Principles and Analysis — Maurice Olley; edited by William F. Milliken & Douglas L. Milliken | Car Design | Chassis design fundamentals and the reasoning behind vehicle layout and suspension choices.
7 Tune to Win — Carroll Smith | Car Setup | An easier read than Race Car Vehicle Dynamics; approachable as a practical setup guide.
8 The Unfair Advantage — Mark Donohue with Paul Van Valkenburgh | Racing / Car Development | Donohue's account of racing and developing cars.
9 Vehicle Handling Dynamics — Masato Abe | Vehicle Dynamics | An engineering treatment of vehicle handling and its mathematical models.
10 Generalized Vehicle Dynamics — Daniel E. Williams | Vehicle Dynamics | A vehicle-modeling reference written by a Purdue professor.
11 Racing Car Design and Development — Len Terry & Alan Baker | Car Design | Racing-car design choices and the process of developing a car.
12 Competition Car Suspension — Allan Staniforth | Suspension | Suspension layout, geometry, and setup for competition cars.
13 The Perfect Car — Nick Skeens | Biography | John Barnard's career and approach to racing-car design. I have not read it yet.
14 Basic Vehicle Dynamics and Suspension Design — R. Dale White | Vehicle Dynamics | Vehicle-dynamics fundamentals applied to suspension design.
15 Inspired to Design — Nigel Bennett | Biography / Car Design | A racing-car designer's career and the development of his cars.
16 Vibration Control of Vehicle Suspension Systems — Haiping Du, Panshuo Li & Donghong Ning | Vibrations | Suspension vibration and control methods. I have not read it yet.
17 The Dynamics of the Race Car — Danny Nowlan | Vehicle Dynamics | Race-car behavior, modeling and simulation.
18 Race Car Design — Derek Seward | Car Design | A practical engineering approach to designing a race car.
19 Beast — Jade Gurss | Motorsport History / Engineering Case Study | The story of the engine project behind Penske's 1994 Indianapolis 500 effort.
20 How to Build a Car — Adrian Newey | Biography / Car Design | Newey's career and approach to racing-car design. I have not read it yet.
21 Total Competition: Lessons in Strategy from Formula One — Ross Brawn & Adam Parr | Strategy | Racing leadership, competition and decision-making. I have not read it yet.

22 Formula One Race Engineering: Optimizing a Driver's Performance with a Winning Method — Ernesto Desiderio | General Race Engineering | A method for analyzing and improving driver performance. I have not read it yet.
23 A Practical Guide to Race Car Data Analysis — Bob Knox | Data Analysis | Practical methods for turning race-car data into useful conclusions.
24 Making Sense of Squiggly Lines — Chris Brown | Data Analysis | Focuses on driver performance, particularly when working with less experienced or nonprofessional drivers.
25 Learn How To Master The Art Of Kart Driving — Terence Dove | Kart Driving | I have not read it, but it was recommended to me for drivers moving from car racing to karting.
26 Two-Stroke Tuner's Handbook — Gordon Jennings | Two-Stroke Engines | An older reference useful for understanding engines from the Yamaha KT100 era. Newer references may also be worth exploring.

27 An Introduction to Statistical Learning — Gareth James, Daniela Witten, Trevor Hastie & Robert Tibshirani (R edition) | Statistics | Statistical-learning methods useful for modeling and data analysis. https://www.statlearning.com/
